tool.name: Merge mOTUs tables
tool.description: combines several mOTUs profiles into one table
tool.command: @DATABASE_DIR_SETUP@ motus merge -db '$DATABASE_DIR' -i #for $file in $files: '$file' #end for -o merged.motus && mv merged.motus '$output_txt'

param.name: files
param.label: mOTUs profiles
param.help: Two or more profiles generated with the same mOTUs database and the same profiling parameters

param.name: db_source
param.label: mOTUs database source
param.option: Use a database from the history

validator.message: No compatible motus database is available

param.name: database_path
param.label: mOTUs database archive
param.help: The tar.gz archive of the mOTUs marker gene database that was used to create the profiles

tool.help:
# Merge mOTUs profiles
Combine several single-sample mOTUs profiles into one multi-sample table.
All profiles must have been generated with the same mOTUs database version and the same profiling parameters, and every sample name must be unique.
## Output
A tabular file with one row per mOTU and one abundance column per input sample. mOTUs that were not detected in a sample get an abundance of 0.
